# `spellcheck.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow (set false for self-hosted runners) | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| aspell_packages | apt packages providing the dictionaries pyspelling needs | `string` | `aspell aspell-en` | no |
| config | Path to the pyspelling config | `string` | `.spellcheck/spellcheck.yml` | no |
| name | pyspelling --name (the matrix entry in the config) | `string` | `Markdown` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
